svg.title: Four kinds of embedding cloud and what four diagnostics report
svg.desc: Four two-dimensional point clouds: a healthy isotropic cloud, a complete collapse to a point, a dimensional collapse onto the diagonal line, and a decorrelated but dependent parabola. Below, a table of per-dimension standard deviation, mean absolute correlation, effective rank and total variance for each.
svg.text: What each diagnostic reports on these 300-point clouds
Synthetic points made for this note: a teaching illustration, not a training trajectory.
